title: feat(festivals-calendar): implement Enterprise Indian Festivals & Cultural Calendar Explorer Suite (#3635)
head: dipanshubatra:feature/enterprise-indian-festivals-cultural-calendar-suite
body:
## Section Summary
Implemented an **Enterprise Indian Festivals & Cultural Calendar Explorer Suite** featuring an interactive HTML/CSS/JS dashboard for exploring India's festivals, monthly calendar, and cultural traditions — with analytics visualizations and a comprehensive Vitest test suite.

## Related Issue
Fixes #3635

## Type of Change
- [x] Feature
- [x] UI/UX Improvement
- [x] Documentation
- [x] Testing

## Changes Implemented
- Created Festivals Calendar Dashboard HTML (`frontend/indian-festivals-cultural-calendar/index.html`) — 292 lines
- Created Glassmorphic Dashboard CSS (`frontend/indian-festivals-cultural-calendar/style.css`) — 625 lines
- Created Festival Engine (`frontend/indian-festivals-cultural-calendar/festival-engine.js`) — 644 lines
- Created Vitest Unit Test Suite (`tests/unit/festival-engine.test.mjs`) — 556 lines

**Total: 2,117 lines of code**

## Technical Details
### Frontend
HTML5, Vanilla CSS, and JavaScript dashboard with:
- Glassmorphic dark-mode UI with animated rangoli-pattern hero
- Festival Explorer (16 festivals with season/month/origin/rituals)
- Monthly Calendar (12 months with quarterly filtering)
- Cultural Traditions Database (14 traditions across 5 religions)
- Analytics Dashboard with seasonal distribution, monthly counts, religious breakdown, and heritage timeline
- Global search with multi-term fuzzy matching
- Responsive design with CSS Grid, mobile breakpoints
- WCAG 2.1 AA compliant color contrast and keyboard accessibility

### Engine
`FestivalEngine` class provides:
- Class-based models: `Festival`, `MonthEvent`, `CulturalTradition`
- Filtering by season, quarter, religion
- Multi-term fuzzy search across all text fields
- Sorting by name, month, and origin
- Analytics: seasonal distribution, monthly counts, religious breakdown, timeline
- State management with reset capability

### Testing
- `tests/unit/festival-engine.test.mjs` — 68 tests covering all engine methods, models, filters, analytics, and render functions
